segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose skin became drier from retinoid use, report the lightweight gel hydrates well as a daytime moisturizer, though a couple caution it may not be rich enough on its own for very dry skin, especially at night.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin, temporarily drier due to pregnancy, reports the gel left her skin soft and moisturized without any greasy feeling.
segments.oily: The gel is recommended by one reviewer as a good fit for both oily and dry skin, sinking in without leaving a greasy layer on top of the skin.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer whose skin became sensitive from Retin-A use reports the gel does not sting and caused no issues over repeated use.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who mentions her age, 80, reports the cream feels good on her skin and eases stiffness.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the lightweight gel hydrates effectively without heaviness or grease, including reviewers with dry or combination-turned-dry skin; a couple note it may not be rich enough alone for very dry skin, particularly as a nighttime moisturizer.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers report the gel does not sting or irritate, including one whose skin is sensitized by Retin-A and another who reacts with hives to most daily moisturizers but has no issue with this one.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the gel does not clog pores or cause breakouts; one reviewer whose face broke out in hives and acne reports the breakouts nearly resolved and scarring faded within about a month of use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer recommends the gel for both oily and dry skin, saying it sinks in without leaving a greasy layer.

extraits.titre: Has helped my skin and is really nice!Has helped my skin and is really nice!
extraits.texte: I’ve been using the gel, moisturizer, and gentle cleanser together for a little while now, and overall I’m really happy with the set. The cleanser is super gentle and doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight or dry, which is a big plus for me. It feels like it actually cleans without stripping everything away. The gel and moisturizer both have a really nice, lightweight feel. They absorb quickly and don’t leave any greasy or heavy residue, so they layer well and work great for everyday use. My skin has been feeling softer and more balanced since I started using them. If I had to point out anything, it’s that the moisturizer might not be quite enough on its own if you have very dry skin, but for normal to slightly dry skin it works really well. Overall, a solid routine—simple, gentle, and effective. I’d definitely keep using these.

I have very dry skin due to using a retinoid and being older. I usually use very rich moisturizers but I was interested in trying this Curology gel because I've heard good things about it. The gel is lightweight but it actually really does a good job hydrating. I wouldn't be able to use just this at night but it's a great day cream for me. There's no scent and it absorbs quite quickly on my face. It almost feels like a silky serum. My face doesn't sting when I use it which is an issue for me because it is sensitive due to the Retin-A. I have used this gel about six times and have had no issues with it and it kept my face hydrated during the day. It's quite affordable as well which is always a plus these days. I think it would work really well on people with normal or combination skin.

I don’t like when my face feels greasy which is why I avoid putting on sunscreen under makeup which I know you’re not supposed to do, anyway this moisturizer is amazing I have combination skin but lately it’s been dry due to my pregnancy and this moisturizer has left my skin soft and moisturized without feeling greasy or it feeling thick. I used to have the entire curology subscription but I really only used the moisturizer, I’m glad you can buy it separately. This stuff is amazing and I love using it to prep my skin before makeup ! Does not leave you feeling sticky

I LOVE THIS PRODUCT! I’m in my late 30’s and out of nowhere I broke out in bad hives and acne all over my face and it wouldn’t go away! I did a lot of research and decided to try this and omg let me tell you! Very soft and light and leaves my skin very bright and hydrated I wear no face makeup anymore and people compliment my skin often! The breakouts are almost completely gone after not even a month and the scars from the big ones are fading away! BUY THIS! I will be making this my regular moisturizer from now on!

extraits.titre: Best moisturizer for oily and dry skin
extraits.texte: Best moisturizer I have ever used! Sinks into skin, and because it’s a gel it doesn’t leave a greasy layer on top of skin. My face feels perfectly soft and my makeup goes on flawlessly!

Every single daily moisturizer i have bought leaves me with hives after just two seconds on my skin, this does not it absorbs right away and is gel so it isn't greasy and heavy, it's perfect! I can use it under makeup that typically cakes and dries out also so this is perfect!
My 80 year old skin really likes this cream. It’s not greasy, spreads smoothly, takes the stiffness away. Very nice product for the face.
